about_text:
MapBarber {version}
Trim stray voxels, points and pixels, and fill the bald spots in robot maps.
controls_general:
Open maps with Ctrl+O or drop files onto the window. Each file opens in its own tab:

· .bt / .ot / voxel .npz → voxel map editor
· .pcd / .ply / .xyz / .csv / .npy → point cloud editor
· map .yaml / .pgm / .png → 2D occupancy grid editor

Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab: next / previous tab   ·   Ctrl+W: close tab
controls_voxel:
Left drag: rotate   ·   Middle drag or Space + drag: pan   ·   Wheel or Ctrl+= / Ctrl+−: zoom
1 front · 3 side · 7 top · 0 / Home: isometric

Tools:  H navigate   V select   E erase   B add   I measure
[ / ]: smaller / larger brush
Select: click selects the brush cube   ·   right click: deselect   ·   Ctrl + drag: paint with the brush while the view stays still
Erase: click removes the brush cube
Add: click a voxel face to grow one layer; click empty space to place voxels on the work plane
Measure: click two points; hold Shift to lock to an axis

Shift + drag: rectangle select   ·   Shift + right drag: rectangle deselect
Delete: erase selection   ·   Backspace: undo last selection step   ·   Esc / Ctrl+D: deselect
Ctrl+A: select all visible   ·   Ctrl+Shift+I: invert selection
Box: drag the coloured arrows to move it along x / y / z, the dots to resize it
Slice: cut the space with a plane, edit one side, then Restore view
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z (Ctrl+Y): undo / redo   ·   Ctrl+S: save
controls_cloud:
Left drag: rotate   ·   Middle drag or Space + drag: pan   ·   Wheel or Ctrl+= / Ctrl+−: zoom
1 front · 3 side · 7 top · 0 / Home: isometric

Tools:  H navigate   V select   E erase   I measure
[ / ]: smaller / larger brush radius
Select / Erase: click a point to affect every point inside the brush sphere   ·   right click: deselect   ·   Ctrl + drag: paint with the brush while the view stays still
Measure: click two points; hold Shift to lock to an axis
Noise filters only select; press Delete to remove what they found.

Shift + drag: rectangle select   ·   Shift + right drag: rectangle deselect
Delete: erase selection   ·   Backspace: undo last selection step   ·   Esc / Ctrl+D: deselect
Ctrl+A: select all visible   ·   Ctrl+Shift+I: invert selection
Box: drag the coloured arrows to move it along x / y / z, the dots to resize it
Slice: cut the space with a plane, edit one side, then Restore view
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z (Ctrl+Y): undo / redo   ·   Ctrl+S: save (all point fields are kept)
controls_grid:
Wheel or Ctrl+= / Ctrl+−: zoom   ·   Middle / right drag or Space + drag: pan   ·   Ctrl+0 / Home: fit

Tools:  H navigate   B pen   L line   R rectangle   G fill   I measure
O / F / U: paint occupied / free / unknown   ·   [ / ]: thinner / thicker pen
Shift (Line, Measure): lock to 0°, 45° or 90°
Shift (Rectangle): square   ·   Alt: draw from the centre
Shift + click (Pen): straight line from the last point

Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z (Ctrl+Y): undo / redo   ·   Ctrl+S: save (YAML is written next to the image)
welcome_text:
A barbershop for robot maps.
Open or drop an OctoMap, a point cloud or a 2D occupancy grid — the right editor opens by itself.
brush_tip: Select/Erase use a cube with this edge length; Add places one layer of this width.
plane_tip: With the Add tool, clicking empty space places voxels on this horizontal plane.
islands_tip: Selects small groups of voxels that touch nothing else. Review them, then press Delete.
box_fill_tip: Marks every cell inside the box as occupied.
crop_tip: Keeps only the points inside the box.
range_tip: Anything outside this range is hidden and cannot be edited.
voxel_legend:
White: added since last save · Pink: selected
Axes at the map origin: x red, y green, z blue
cloud_legend:
Pink: selected
Axes at the cloud origin: x red, y green, z blue
grid_legend:
Black: occupied · White: free · Grey: unknown
Red and green arrows: map origin x and y
cloud_brush_tip: Select/Erase affect every point within this distance of the clicked point.
outliers_tip: Selects points whose average distance to their neighbours is far above the norm.
sparse_tip: Selects points with too few neighbours inside the search radius.
thin_tip: Keeps one point per cubic cell and removes the rest (undoable).
grid_brush_tip: Width of the pen and line tools in cells.
speckles_tip: Turns small isolated occupied blobs into free space.
trim_tip: Crops the unknown margin around the map and moves the origin so nothing shifts.
voxel_size_new: Voxel size of the new map [m]:
voxel_counts: Voxels {n} (visible {v})  ·  unsaved +{a} / −{r}  ·  selected {s}  ·  voxel size {res} m
status_islands: {n} islands, {m} voxels selected — review, then press Delete
status_filter: {n} points selected — review, then press Delete
status_converted: Converted the {source} to a {kind} — not saved yet
status_box_empty: The box contains no cell centre; enlarge it
empty_map: The map is empty; there is nothing to save.
box_too_large: The box holds {n} cells; the limit is 2,000,000.
box_handles_tip: Drag the coloured arrows in the 3D view to move the box along x, y or z, and the dots on its faces to resize it.
slice_tip: Cut the space with a plane and work on one side. The other side is hidden and protected until you restore the view.
status_view_restored: View restored — everything is visible again
ruler_tip: With the Measure tool, click two points to read the real distance between them.
ruler_tip_grid: With the Measure tool, click two cells to read the distance in metres and in pixels.
ruler_hint: Measure tool: click a first point, then a second.
ruler_second: First point set — click the second point
ruler_detail_voxel:
Distance {d:.3f} m  ·  {cells:.1f} voxels
Δx {dx:+.3f}   Δy {dy:+.3f}   Δz {dz:+.3f} m
ruler_detail_cloud:
Distance {d:.3f} m
Δx {dx:+.3f}   Δy {dy:+.3f}   Δz {dz:+.3f} m
ruler_detail_grid:
Distance {d:.3f} m  ·  {px:.1f} px
Δx {dx:+.3f} m   Δy {dy:+.3f} m
{dc:+d} × {dr:+d} cells
status_brush: {n} points in the brush  ·  {d:.2f} m from the camera
